title: Exact satisfiability threshold for random k-SAT for small k (k = 3)
exact_target: What exact clause-to-variable ratio separates almost-sure satisfiability from almost-sure unsatisfiability in the standard independent random 3-SAT model?

sources.citation: I. Caragiannis, N. Gravin, and Z. Jiang, On the Satisfiability of Random 3-SAT Formulas with k-Wise Independent Clauses, LIPIcs ESA 2025, Article 103, Introduction.
